To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the choice of NGS library preparation method plays a critical role in the quality of the data generated and that, for Mycobacterium, the Illumina Truseq kit produces more uniform coverage than the Nextera kit.
the choice of NGS library preparation method is critical to the quality of the sequence data generated, and that the Nextera and the TruSeq methods have different strengths and weaknesses.
the Nextera XT and TruSeq DNA library preparation kits produce different quality NGS data when applied to MTB DNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for the rapid, accurate and cost-effective analysis of the genomes of Mycobacterum tuberculosis, the causative agent of tuberculosis.
the optimization of library construction protocols for use with Mycobacterium species and other microorganisms with high genomic GC-content and/or low DNA purity.
the development of a new method for the preparation of DNA samples for NGS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TruSeq library preparation protocol is more appropriate for the NGS of MTB genomes than the Nextera library preparation method.
the Nextera XT protocol is not recommended for use with M. tuberculosis.
the TruSeq method produces more uniform data and that it is the best method for sequencing MTB genomes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Nextera XT kit is a fast and simple way to produce high-quality data from MTB isolates.
the TruSeq method is superior for sequencing MTB genomes.
the Illumina Tru-Seq method is the better method for sequencing M. tuberculosis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of DNA library preparation method is critical to the quality of the sequence data produced and that the TruSeq method is preferable for MTB.

, in the case of MTB, the choice of library construction kit has a significant effect on the quality of sequence reads generated, and the TruSeq library construction kit produces more uniform coverage of the genome than the Nextera method, regardless of input DNA quality.
the choice of DNA isolation kit and sequencing library preparation kit is critical to the generation of high quality sequence data for MTB.
